summary: Enforce signed gateway and owner authority watches for remote PEEK

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION remains11; no checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Remote PEEK requires both gateway and owner lease support and fails closed after five seconds without fresh signed authority proof. Accepted owner authority proofs enable screen reads immediately without waiting for a heartbeat. Mixed old/new endpoints fail closed; ATTACH is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Upgrade both endpoints before relying on remote PEEK. Consumers must recover EOF by fresh acquisition, never replay a consumed capability.

recovery.detail: No data rewrite or destructive migration; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged. Older builds retain their older observation enforcement.
